notes: Two private Python environments, created on request under runtime/engines. They are separate because the speech-to-text models need transformers 5 (ParakeetForTDT) while XTTS-v2 relies on transformers 4 internals that version 5 removed. Speech to text runs on the CPU: a 20 second recording is transcribed in about 1.4 s here, and the GPU stays free for the chat model and the voices.
